title: Drinkable Buckets
description: Adds drinkable buckets to the game
body:
**This mod adds drinkable buckets to your game!**
In this mod, you can craft drinkable buckets using normal buckets crafted with spider eyes!

This is how you can craft a drinkable water bucket:

![Drinkable Water Bucket](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5888087606ca2fef6109719dbb3b9099d669f55e.png)
